title: Time & Logic: 以前 / 以后, 的时候, 从…到…, 因为…所以, 但是, 或者 / 还是, 离
description: Before/after, when, from … to …, because … so, but, 'or' in statements vs questions, and distance with 离.

points.title: Time / verb + 以前 / 以后
points.summary: 以前 = before; 以后 = after. They follow the time or the event.
points.body:
- 到北京**以后**，给我打电话.
- 三年**以前**，我还不会说中文.
examples: Call me after you arrive in Beijing.

points.title: …的时候: when
points.body:
- 我小**的时候**很喜欢画画儿.
- 我上大学**的时候**学过法语.
examples: {我|wǒ}{小|xiǎo}{的|de}{时候|shíhou}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{画画儿|huà huàr}。
When I was little, I loved drawing.

points.title: 从 A 到 B: from A to B
points.summary: 从 … 到 … for time and place.
points.body:
- 我**从**九点**到**五点工作.
- **从**我家**到**学校要二十分钟.
examples: I work from nine to five.

points.title: 因为 … 所以 …: because … so
points.summary: 因为 introduces the reason, 所以 the result. Either can stand alone.
examples: The match was cancelled because of the rain.

points.title: 可是 / 但是: but
points.summary: 可是 and 但是 both mean 'but' and start the second clause. 可是 is a bit more spoken.
points.body: - 这件衣服很漂亮，**可是**太贵了.
examples: I want to go, but I don't have time.

points.title: 或者 vs 还是: or
points.summary: 或者 = or in **statements** (either is fine). 还是 = or in **questions** (choose one).
points.body:
- 我们周末去爬山**或者**去游泳吧.
- 你想喝茶**还是**咖啡?
examples: Would you like tea or coffee?

points.title: A 离 B + 近 / 远: distance
points.summary: A 离 B 很近 / 很远 = A is close to / far from B.
examples: My home is close to the office.

notes: 时间 = 'time' (a noun) — doesn't follow a verb like this.
You can't call 'before arriving' to report arriving.
后来 = 'later on' (past narrative), not after a verb.
questions.translation: Give me a call after you arrive in Beijing.

questions.prompt: {三|sān}{年|nián}（　），{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{不|bú}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{中文|Zhōngwén}，{现在|xiànzài}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
notes: 以后 = 'in three years' — clashes with 现在说得很好.
questions.translation: Three years ago I couldn't speak Chinese; now I speak it well.
When I was little, I loved drawing.

notes: 的时候 follows the whole clause, subject included.
的时候 follows the whole clause.
questions.translation: I studied French when I was at university.

notes: 到九点到五点 isn't grammatical.
在九点到五点 isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: I work from nine to five every day.

notes: 从 … 离 isn't the pattern.
从 … 在 isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: It takes twenty minutes from my home to school.

notes: 如果 = 'if' — doesn't pair with 所以 and a past 了.
所以 introduces the result, which comes later.
questions.translation: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
He was ill, so he didn't come to class.

notes: 所以 = 'so' — 'pretty, so too expensive' is illogical.
questions.translation: This piece of clothing is pretty, but too expensive.
I'd really like to go, but I don't have time.

notes: 还是 is 'or' in questions — this is a suggestion.
questions.translation: Let's go hiking or swimming this weekend.

notes: 或者 doesn't make an either-or question.
茶和咖啡 = 'tea and coffee' — not a choice.
questions.translation: Would you like tea or coffee?

notes: 到 isn't used for distance like this.
从 needs 到 and a verb.
questions.translation: My home is close to the office — a five-minute walk.

notes: Distance uses 离, not 从.
questions.translation: The school is far from my home.
